SASBDB entry SASDPU6  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDPU6/)

Publication: Structure of a 28.5 kDa duplex-embedded G-quadruplex system resolved to 7.4 Å resolution with cryo-EM.
DOI:         https://doi.org/10.1093/nar/gkad014

The publisher's PDF used to be kept in this folder. It was removed from the repository
(size, and the publisher's redistribution terms): fetch it from the DOI above. The
fitting script test/fitting_tests/SASDPU6/ cites the sections and tables it takes the
buffer and sample conditions from.
